descriptor: Phase Three schema, pipeline logic, and portal readiness
status: Phase Two remains live; Phase Three pipeline and schema decisions advanced
signal: VA Claims Edge moved from a Phase Two review surface into Phase Three planning this week: the team clarified the seven-stage pipeline, ownership rules, booking inputs, portal subdomain, and compliance questions before real client data is introduced.
goal: Align the approved pipeline and booking rules, complete the schema and backend changes, and instrument the production journey before real claimant data is used.
work: Kept the Phase Two weekly report and unified portal review as the current client-facing baseline.
Reviewed David's latest process feedback and translated it into a formal seven-stage pipeline with owners and event-based advancement.
Advanced the schema and pipeline change list, including stop-the-clock handling, stage ownership, alerts, appointments, and client self-registration.
Confirmed the portal subdomain and kept compliance review visible before real claimant data enters the system.
analysis: This week's work was product and process alignment. The portal foundation is live, while the team is now making the underlying pipeline and booking rules match the approved business process.
The next risk is not visual polish. It is rule alignment, compliance review, and production instrumentation before the system handles real claimant records.
